title: WEDDING ENSEMBLE: DRESS (A), TRAIN (B), VEIL (C), SLIP (D), GARTERS (E,F), FAN (G), AND HANGER (H)
medium: silk charmeuse, beads, tulle (a); silk charmeuse, beads, tulle, artificial orange blossoms (b); silk tulle, artificial orange blossoms, wire (c); silk, silk chiffon, silk tulle (d); silk satin, lace, artificial orange blossoms (e,f); ivory, feathers (g); silk, tulle, artificial orange blossoms (h)

identifying_description: Woman’s wedding ensemble comprised of: (a) ivory silk charmeuse dress with bateau neckline and long sleeves tapered to wrists, secured by five silk charmeuses-covered buttons each, and full knee-length skirt, accented along collar and at cuffs with white and ivory beading, with beaded silk tulle insertions at waist, forming tassels over skirt; (b) ivory silk charmeuse cathedral-length train with tulle and beaded edging, culminating in elaborately beaded hem decorated with artificial orange blossoms; (c) cathedral-length silk tulle veil with crown of artificial orange blossoms secured by wire; (d) ivory silk plain weave slip with chiffon skirt and sheer tulle shoulders, secured by hook-and-eye closured at back; (e, f) silk satin and lace garters, in ivory and blue, with artificial orange blossoms; (g) carved ivory and feather fan; (h) hanger in ivory silk and tulle with artificial orange blossoms and heart-shaped sachet.
